description: Canonical capability and installation map for generated agent adapters. Platforms without an adapter are recorded separately from their other APT surfaces.

claude.label: Claude Code
limitations: Generated agent bodies replace repository-relative skill links with installed skill identifiers.

codex.label: Codex
codex.executionSurface: Generated role prompt blocks in the Codex agent directory
limitations: The emitted format is role prompt content, not a Codex-specific native agent configuration.

cursor.label: Cursor
limitations: The emitted agent body is a rule prompt, not a platform-native subagent definition.

copilot.label: GitHub Copilot
copilot.executionSurface: Generated GitHub Copilot custom agent definitions
limitations: The generated tool list maps abstract APT capabilities to the available Copilot tool identifiers.

gemini.label: Gemini CLI
limitations: APT distributes Gemini CLI commands under .gemini/commands; it does not currently generate agent adapters.
